overall_goal: Perform various kitchen management tasks including cleaning, organizing ingredients, and washing hands

goals.rationale: The person opens a drawer, takes out the scales, closes the drawer, and places the scales on the counter.

goals.description: Clean the counter and throw away rubbish
goals.rationale: The person sweeps rubbish from the counter into their hand, opens the bin, and throws the rubbish away.

goals.description: Take out eggs and egg whites from the fridge
goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge multiple times to retrieve a packet of eggs and a bowl of egg whites.

goals.description: Throw away eggshells and rinse hands
goals.rationale: The person disposes of empty eggshells in the bin and then rinses their hands under the tap.
The person opens and closes the dishwasher drawers to look for something.

goals.description: Retrieve a pan and sugar for weighing
goals.rationale: The person gets a pan, places it on the scales, and then retrieves sugar from the cupboard.
The person turns on the tap, uses soap to scrub their hands, rinses them, and dries them on a towel.

goals.description: Retrieve chocolate buttons and close the jar
goals.rationale: The person takes a jar of chocolate buttons from the cupboard, uses it, and then secures the lid.

goals.description: Rearrange ingredients on the counter and turn off the scales
goals.rationale: The person moves the butter dish lid, shifts the egg box, places the bowl of eggs on the scales, and turns the scales off.

goals.description: Put the sugar away and retrieve the mixer
goals.rationale: The person places the sugar back into the cupboard and then takes out the mixer from the bottom shelf.

goals.description: Store eggs and egg whites back in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person clears the counter by moving bowls and scales, then places the egg box and egg whites back into the fridge.

goals.description: Check the consistency of the mixture
goals.rationale: The person dips the mixer blades into the mixture to check its stiffness, shakes off the excess, and sets the mixer down.

goals.description: Close the flour jar and prepare the spatula
goals.rationale: The person puts down the measuring spoon, screws the lid back onto the flour jar, and picks up a spatula.

goals.description: Add more flour to the mixture
goals.rationale: The person opens the flour jar to add more flour, places the jar back, and uses the spatula to mix.

goals.description: Wash hands and retrieve a spoon
goals.rationale: The person rinses and dries their hands, then opens the cutlery drawer to get a spoon.
The person unplugs the mixer, releases the blades, and places the dirty blades into a pan.

goals.description: Tidy up the counter and put away tools
goals.rationale: The person cleans up by placing a dirty knife in a pan, covering the butter dish, putting the scales in a drawer, and returning the measuring spoon.
